notes: Standalone village build on timor_demo with the per-unit site storage cap set to 0 MWh: the run solves, but no site storage can be built, so solar+storage microgrids collapse to solar+diesel (zero Total_Storage_MWh at every site, higher Variable_Costs_Village / diesel Electricity_GWh). The output-analyzer should flag it; the fix is raising village_storage_max_mwh (Tier B), after which storage is built. LP-relaxed expansion so it solves in minutes on HiGHS.
